The Hong Kong Observatory said on Wednesday that the stretch began on November 24, with sunsets of 5.38pm or earlier continuing until December 2.
Although the winter solstice falls on December 22, Hong Kong’s earliest sunsets usually occur in late November, while its latest sunrises do not arrive until mid-January, it said.
